newsitem.title: CHINA: China promises good treatment for Gore on visit.
newsitem.headline: China promises good treatment for Gore on visit.

text.p: Chinese Premier Li Peng said on Friday that U.S. Vice President Al Gore would receive "very good treatment" during his visit to China this month.
"Vice President Al Gore... will receive very good treatment," Li said.
Li said Gore would visit China at his invitation.

Gore's visit later this month would pave the way for an exchange of visits between U.S. President Bill Clinton and his Chinese counterpart Jiang Zemin, Li said. Jiang is expected to visit the United States later this year.
Gore's trip to China will be the highest level visit by a U.S. official since Beijing's 1989 crackdown on student-led pro-democracy demonstrations.
